articleTitle: Problems of Quality of Education in the Implementation of Online Courses in the Educational Process
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The article deals with the problems of the quality of education at the Institute of Industrial Management, Economics and Trade of the St. Petersburg Polytechnic University using the developed and implemented mass open online courses (MOOCs). The introduction of online courses in the educational process has become one of the priorities of the advanced universities in Russia. At St. Petersburg Polytechnic University, active development of the most popular online courses is being conducted, which all universities in the country could use in training. Features of development of online courses for training and the order of their use are described. The article reveals the experience of implementing online courses in the educational process. The problems of the quality of education in the application of mixed instruction are analyzed.

articleTitle: Impact of the Internal Factors on the Competitiveness of Business Organizations
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Competitiveness is a key feature for the management of the modern organizations. Its development and sustainability are based on the use of the available resources with optimal efficiency, the organization's ability to adapt to the fast changing environment, as well as the speed and efficiency of the implementation of innovations. The purposeful increase of an organization's competitiveness is connected with investments in human resources development, technological renovations and improvement of the work conditions as a whole.

articleTitle: Aspects of Training in the Field of Operations Management with Respect to Industry 4.0
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Industry 4.0 is considered as a set of related technology and digital solutions that, on the one hand, support the development of automation, integration and real-time data exchange in production processes and, on the other, lead to changes that business, society and humans (either as consumers, or as employees) should be adapted to. New production environment based on the Internet of Things, Industrial Internet, Cloud-based Manufacturing and Smart Manufacturing, creates also new requirements for the operations managers running the production system.The present paper discusses the requirements concerning education and training in the field of Operations Management, particularly with a view on ensuring efficient management of the production system with respect to an Industry 4.0 environment.

articleTitle: Principles of Designing Automated Logistics Systems - Hybrid Component of Cyber-Physical Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The paper enquires into the possibilities of providing automation solutions for diverse flows of information being transmitted, on the one hand, from within the logistics system itself, between its inner components and on the other hand - between the logistics system and its external environment. Being the constituent parts of the logistics information system, they tend to lay down the requirements for its automation. The primary purpose of the present paper is to examine the logistics information system (LIS) as an organised set of interconnected technical and electronic tools, including computer technologies and various software products. They work best in solving particular functional tasks that are crucial for maintaining automated control of material flow, which, in fact, is the first step towards engineering cyber systems and Smart factories.

articleTitle: Infrared Array Sensor Wireless Network
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: This paper is focused on using multiple infrared array sensors with relatively low resolution, which are connected in a network. The temperature of objects from different spatial positions of the sensors is measured. The data is transmitted wirelessly and collected in a server. The data is stored for future processing and searching for dependencies among the measurements. We take into account the basic sources of error in different measurement scenarios.

articleTitle: Development of Speech Recognition Algorithm and LabView Model for Voice Command Control of Mobille Robot Motio
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: One of the main tasks in development of intelligent mobile robots is motion control. Some of them are based on the existing and mounted on the mobile robot different sensors, suitable to self-mobile robots control during their motion within outdoor or indoor environments. There are others applications and tasks, where the mobile robot interacts with person or people. For these situations is needed to arrange the so called "human-mobile robot interface", from which is possible to establish mobile robot motion control via human voice or gesture commands. Therefore, the goal in this article is to develop the speech recognition algorithm and model, based on myRIO embedded device and LabView graphical programming language, for audio control of mobile robot motion with voice commands.

articleTitle: Research and Evaluation of Factors and Sub-Factors that Affect on the Timeliness and Reliability of Deliveries and Their Importance for the Efficiency of the Logistic Processes
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: One of the most important factors, affecting on the entire efficiency of the logistic processes is the well-timed and safe delivery. On one hand, it should be done on time and on the other hand - its integrity shouldn't be broken anyway. Hense, for the purpose of the current paper, the authors research what's the impact of timeliness and reliability of the deliveries on the efficiency of the logistic processes. This research is based on the expert evaluation, given by precisely selected respondents, who present their opinion for the impact level of all the factors and sub-factors over the theme and object of the study. As a result of this empirical research, conducted with the help of a specially written inquiry card, the authors present the summarized data, which is also analyzed in graphic images. Then they make conclusions and proposals for improving of the weaker criteria, whilst keeping the satisfying levels of the stronger ones.

articleTitle: Possibilities for Implementing Production "Automation Islands" in an Automatic Production System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Modern production is already being built on the basis of new technologies and forms the so-called "automation islands". Essentially, these are self-contained, automated or automatically functioning components for electronic control, artificial intelligence, computer-integrated production activities, etc. They are built to minimize human labor in the production activity and to essentially determine the development of automation at this stage. This aim for a complex improvement of these activities will increasingly be a major factor in the development of automation. This means that in the future, based on new communication and computer achievements, nanotechnologies and other technical solutions, not only will the production structure change globally, but also will approaches and ways of automating production processes change. Production will be considered as a whole, including both technology, technological information processes and operationally and functionally integrated production components. This can only be done with the help of automation that creates the possibility of horizontal and vertical integration.

articleTitle: Integration Levels of Company Logistics in Intelligent Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The current article considers integrative levels of company's logistics in intelligent manufacturing processes. Those are levels of integration of various production activities as technological, logistical and so on, forming productivity structure. Those activities should be integrated to each other for the sake of the successful cyber-productivity system functioning. The aim of the article is to scrutinize the way those activities (components) interrelate and what connections they have to the material and virtual logistics processes. Further, the integrative levels of intelligent logistics will be mentioned and on that basis the connections to the input/inbound logistics will be examined. This will create the opportunity for improving logistics system's functionality and effectiveness, as well as bringing to time-saving through the whole logistics chain under the conditions of cyber proceedings.

articleTitle: Obtaining of Copper Coatings on Dielectrics from Non-Formaldehyde Electroless Copper Plating Bath
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Commercial electroless copper plating solution often use formaldehyde or its derivatives as reducing agent and are operated at pH values above 11. The high pH is not compatible with some dielectric or photoresist materials. In this work the non-formaldehyde electroless copper plating solution with weakly alkaline pH was developed. The influence of pH value and adding of nickel ions to the solution on deposition rate was investigated. The morphology, structure and the surface chemistry of the obtained copper layers was investigated by scanning electron microscopy (SEM), X-ray diffraction (XRD) and X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS).

articleTitle: Approach for Development of Real-Time Marshalling Yard Management System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: In this paper, we present an approach for development of a novel real-time marshalling yard management system (RTMYMS). Based on an advanced simulation/optimization approach the expected impacts shall lead to improved punctuality, system efficiency and competitiveness of freight rail transportation, particularly of marshalling yards as important nodes in railway freight network. Based on the state of the art in yard operations the requirements for a RTMYMS are defined. These requirements should serve as a framework for the IT solution and the experimental proof of concept. In next step the IT solution should be implemented and tested in order to be verified in a real-world marshalling yard. An intelligent decision-making on a real-time basis is therefore required and presents a main element of automation and optimization in marshalling yards.

articleTitle: Use of System Diversity as Tool for Identification
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: This paper concerns application of diversity, widely known from the reliability theory, in the new aspect as a tool for identification in recognition systems. If the information enters from two or more different sources in the recognition system, it can be treated by three different ways: logical schemes OR, AND and methods used in the artificial intelligence as fuzzy logic and neural networks. Based on the criterion system of quantitative indicators evaluating the identification, here it is suggested an analytical approach for creation of diversity recognition function with maximal identification.

articleTitle: Modeling of Series Resonant DC-DC Power Converters
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: In the work are realized and presented models of the most commonly used series resonant DC-DC converters: a serial and a parallel loaded capacitor. Models are synthesized using differential equations and switching functions. In this way, it is convenient to formalize the power circuits in question and complex mathematical software does not have to be used to solve the system of differential equations. The obtained models allow to synthesize robust control of the converters and perform optimization on certain criteria. The proposed modeling approach is very suitable for use in power electronics training because it allows the description of various electronic energy converters where there is a switch between two or more states.

articleTitle: Characterization of the Traffic in IP-Based Communication Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: In the following paperwork an analysis and characterization of the traffic in an IP - based networks have been made. An efficient and inexpensive method for monitoring of these kinds of network has been proposed. The used tools are so selected that they can provide enough information for characterizing the traffic in the monitored communication networks. Measurements are carried out and the monitored parameters are: the usability of the ports from a particular protocol, types of protocols, generated information, the packet sizes and etc. Approximations have been made by special software. The made approximations are for the packet size and the moments between entries of the packets.

articleTitle: Production Structure Optimization For The Bulgarian Power System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: In supplement to [1] a modified model is described for bottom-up optimization of the production structure in an electric power system, which supplies nonelastic consumers. The objective function aims for minimization of supply costs, based on producer bids and subject to the constraints of active energy balance. The model is verified by a numerical example illustrating a study for the Bulgarian power system expansion. Analysis is performed and some important conclusions are drawn.

articleTitle: Some Aspects for the Integration of Sensor Networks in Cloud Structures
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Research on WSN are extremely attractive in recent years to both the scientific community and the industry. WSN provides the opportunity to present new interesting information gathering solutions in many areas of industrial automation, households, healthcare, environmental monitoring, agriculture, border security, etc. The capabilities of today's industry in the field of sensor design provide exponential growth of WSN-derived data. These data currently is not fully utilize appropriately by the use of ineffective tools for processing sensor data and their preservation for future processing and use. Today's WSN opens up a new perspective to more effectively analyze, process, and apply collected data by integrating them into Cloud Computing technologies. Based on the cloud-based sensor integration scheme, the report analyzed the possible WSN integration structures with Cloud Computing, as well as some of the challenges in integrating Wireless Sensor Networks (WSN) made up of low-power wireless field devices, with cloud infrastructures that allow remote access via secure communication channels in real time.

articleTitle: Scientific Knowledge – Source of a Competitive Advantage in Security
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Education is one of the fundamental values of the modern world and without it there will not be a foundation upon which the society can step in to move forward. Modern organisations of science, education, and qualifications in the security system are becoming more and more dependent on knowledge because they have to become "knowledge factories" and their basic product has predominantly become ideas rather than tangible products. A key to success is the fundamental change in the role of science in our academic life by creating a sustainable institutional model for research into the national security system.

articleTitle: A Cynefin Framework for Agile Decision Making of AI BOTS
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The concept decision-making AI Bots is introduced. The modern Agile systems and structures are analyzed. A methodological approach of the study using the concept of Cynefin Framework in agile decision making of AI bots is proposed. The Cynefin transitions between the different domains are illustrated through the rotated Snowdon's v45° unfolded cylindric overlapping version. The cycle of adaptive change is used to analyze the effect of Cynefin Framework in the agile decision-making system of AI Bots. Analysis of the results, as well as relevant discussion and conclusions are proposed.

articleTitle: Theoretical and Experimental Study of Interleaved Non-Inverting Buck-Boost Converter for RES
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The DC-DC converters are used in some configurations of modern energy conversion systems using renewable energy sources (RES). One of the topologies of DC-DC converters is non-inverting buck-boost converter, which is suitable for relative low-power applications. The studied circuit consists of two identical converters connected in parallel with common input and output voltage. The study is based on simulations with Matlab/Simscape models. Besides, an experimental test bench is created and used for measurements of converter behavior in different modes of operation. The comparison between theoretical and experimental results show a good degree of overlap.

articleTitle: Methods for Energy Production Estimation from Photovoltaic Plants: Review and Application
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Large penetration of energy produced from PV power plants was observed during the past decade. The solar output forecasting provokes the interest of researchers, grid system operators and power plant managers. The past few years have seen the development of several forecasting techniques: physical, statistical and hybrid. The present article summarizes the main known methods for estimation of power output of photovoltaic power plants. Finally, the authors presented an application of the physical models, calculating the power output of photovoltaic plant from a-Si panels. It was observed that the model is suitable for different meteorological conditions to optimize the prediction of power output.

articleTitle: Identification of the Parameters of a Dual-Mass DC Electromechanical System Using Daubechies Wavelets
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: In this paper the properties of Daubechies wavelets are applied for identification of the parameters of a dual-mass DC electromechanical system mathematical model. The accuracy of the identification is assessed. The relative parameter and the relative output errors are calculated. The obtained results are analyzed, and corresponding conclusions are made.

articleTitle: Modelling and Studying of Cloud Infrastructures
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: In the following paperwork a modelling of cloud infrastructures with specialized software has been made. The reaction of the cloud for low and high traffic loads and different number of users has been studied. Objects of observations are: the core communication network, the aggregation network for distribution of the traffic flows, access network, computing capabilities of the cloud and also the consumed energy from the devices that built it. As a result, from the carried out studies recommendations for optimizations of the modelled cloud infrastructure have been made. The purpose of the recommendations is to improve the efficiency, lowering of the energy consumption and improvements of the energy efficiency.

articleTitle: Solving Electrical Engineering Problems with MATLAB and MULTISIM
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The innovative combination of analysis of electrical circuits with specialized mathematical software that takes advantages of virtual analysis in electrical engineering training enhances the interest of students, not only facilitating the perception of the teaching material but also creating opportunities for further examinations explaining the physical processes. In conjunction with this, it is proposed to introduce the programming environment MULTISIM, Electronics Workbench, and its advantages introducing it in electrical engineering education are presented. Examples of verification and visualization analyzing various types of electric circuits are exposed.

articleTitle: Creating Conditions for Application of Digital Dimensions in Logistics Activity
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The wide diversity and substantial number of linkages in the logistics chain call for more effective ways of communication and information interaction between them. This is particularly necessary and highly relevant today with the transition from a conventional way of production and successful adjustment to smart manufacturing. Thence, all logistics activities should be designed and organised in such a way that they would comply exactly with the requirements of the smart systems. At present, the information systems of the participants in the logistics chain are for the most part incompatible, which, in turn, creates problems with overcoming the places where these interconnections occur. The purpose of the article is to propose effective solutions for creating conditions necessary to ensure possible interaction and faster performance of this process subject to the requirements of the cyberspace. The integration of the participants in the logistics process on the basis of digitization is one way to create the conditions and the respective possibilities for effectuating an electronic exchange, implementing processing and analysis of mutual information. Basically, these are the essential conditions that apply to the use of digital dimensions in the execution of smart production processes and logistics.

articleTitle: Impact Factors in Implementation of EU-Funded Projects in Bulgarian Higher Education Institutions
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: One of the key opportunities for financing the development of Bulgarian state universities is through the opportunities provided by the programs financed by the EU budget. On the other hand, the right choice of alternatives favors the achievement of efficiency and effectiveness of the financial means used. The imposition of a scientifically grounded approach to generating and selection of alternatives can not be achieved without taking into account and quantifying the factors influencing preparation, implementation and reporting. This paper presents the results of an empirical study conducted among Bulgarian state universities to establish the impact values of each of these factors.

articleTitle: Marketing 5.0. Transactions of Artificial Intelligence Systems in The Digital Environment
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The subject of the article is a study of the opportunities that AIS would provide to humanity and its significance for marketing 5.0. The object of this article is AIS understood as an independent participant in the digital markets.

articleTitle: Innovative Joystick Virtual Prototype Ergonomy Validation Methodology By Physical 3d Printed Functional Model
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The present paper was worked out the methodology for innovative joystick virtual prototype ergonomy validation by physical 3d printed functional model

articleTitle: Maintaining Steady Cost Projection on Wastewater Engineering Projects in Bulgaria
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The cost of the engineering project of is one of the most important parameters at every stage of its life cycle and a key factor for its sustainability and efficiency. Over the past few years, some problems have been encountered in predicting the cost of wastewater projects in Bulgaria, which raises serious concerns both for the customers and the contractors of these projects. A significant deviation of actual costs from planned initial costs is noted at the premises. However, no timely measures are taken to correct it. The purpose of this report is to identify, analyze and rank influential factors on the cost variations of the Bulgarian wastewater projects and to suggest possible optimization. To achieve this, a study was conducted between April 2016 and May 2018, in which the authors invited practitioners and experts to participate in a structured survey. The research methodology is of survey-descriptive type. A wide range of research methods are used to successfully achieve the goals and tasks as secondary analysis of empirical data, structured interview, in-depth interviews and triangulation. A total of 43 factors have been identified, of which the greatest impact on the efficiency of engineering projects in Bulgaria is access to financing at the design stage, lowest procurement bidding, inadequate pricing methods and bureaucracy.

articleTitle: Virtual Gaming Platform Customer Experience Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The concept of Virtual Gaming Platform is introduced. The modern type of organizational structure in the virtual gaming ecosystem is analysed. A methodological approach through Structural Equations Modeling (SEM) is suggested. A conceptual model for customer experience evaluation is proposed. Research tools for enlightening latent structures are presented. Analysis of the results, as well as relevant discussion and conclusions are proposed.

articleTitle: A Multistage Approach for Detection of Objects with Rectangular Forms
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: This paper proposes a multistage approach for detection of different objects with rectangular shape forms in real images. It consists of image enhancement, following by edge detection to suppress most possible false edges, and modification of Hough Transform. Peaks of the Hough image are extracted, and a rectangle is detected when these peaks satisfy certain geometric conditions. Some experimental results are given to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Dynamics in the Theory and Practice of the Strategic Management
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The dynamics in the unprecedented transformation of society at the beginning of the 21st century caused significant changes in the concepts of organizations, the views of their mission and the organizational culture of their management. New research in this field has led to changes in the theory and practice of strategic management, becoming the guiding principle for all processes of good governance based on a scientific basis. Governance, as a science, passes through several major stages, which differ in how they study the relationship "organization, environment for its activity and the desired outcome of governance".

articleTitle: Environmental Influence on Renewable Sources Productivity
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The performance of photovoltaic plants is directly related to environmental parameters. This process is affected by different factors, such as temperature, solar radiation and dustiness. The assessment of this impact is made on installed academic photovoltaic system on the roof on the Burgas free university. Performance parameters are measured by using a dedicated monitoring system. Proposed is a device for assessing the degree of contamination of photovoltaic panels and its impact on their productivity.

articleTitle: Development of Control Strategy for Charging Electric Vehicles in Micro and Nanogrid
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The increasing in numbers of electric vehicle could lead to significant consequences for the stability and reliability of the distributed network. Because of this reason in the current paper a new control strategy for charging electric vehicles in micro and nanogrid is proposed. Finding optimal solution for maximal energy storage and usage of redundant energy from EVs in micro and nanogrid is the main reason for this research. A mathematical model is developed and realized in MATLAB.

articleTitle: Concept Model for Assessment of the Economic Security Level in Food Industry Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: For the purposes of this study economic security is regarded as a state, level and capability of development of the industrial enterprise. The assessment of economic security shall take into account both the nature and impact of external factors and, at the same time, the functioning of the enterprise in a financial, economic and productive context in a dynamic market environment. The diversity of the concepts of economic security gives grounds to analyse several common functional components: financial, technological, intellectual, human, political, legal, ecological. Only such a comprehensive assessment can diagnose and provide economic safety for the enterprise. An approach is proposed to assess economic security based on a multi-factor model.

articleTitle: Modelling of Underground Cables : Sensitivity Analysis on the Precision of Parameters
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: This report presents new concept for modelling of high-voltage and extra-high voltage transmission systems, which provide higher accuracy for modelling of underground cables. The growing worldwide demand for electricity influences the transmission system in a way that requires the upgrade and construction of new transmission lines. Also, the high degree of urbanization, the growth of the cities and the social discontent with living nearby overhead lines leads to gradual transition from overhead lines to underground cables at all voltage levels. This paper presents the discrepancies between the real-world situation and the mathematical model due to the specific operation, construction and environment of the cable lines.

articleTitle: 3D Modeling of the Magnetostatic Field in Separation Apparatus
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: This paper is devoted to three-dimensional mathematical modeling of the magnetostatic field in separation apparatus. The created models are based on a specific practical task, given by the manufacturer of the technological equipment. Conclusions are made about the used permanent magnets in the investigated magnetic separators. Using the COMSOL Multiphysics software are developed different versions of the configuration of the magnetic system in order to achieve a maximum degree of purification expressed in maximum extraction of ferromagnetic particles.

articleTitle: Numerical Modeling of the Electromagnetic System in an Induction Brazing System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: In the work is realized and presented a numerical model of the electromagnetic system in an induction brazing plant. Modeling was done in the commercial software Comsol Multiphysics. The model is directed to better understanding of the processes and further optimization on various criteria: the highest efficiency of the energy conversion, minimal losses in the electromagnetic system or the highest performance of the system. The model is two-dimensional, with a series of numerical simulations yielding results that describe the behavior of the system during a complete technological cycle.

articleTitle: Conjugate Heat Transfer Analysis Using 3D FEM Model of an Oil-immersed Distribution Transformer
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Temperature field distribution in transformers active components and oil velocity variation in the tank are important for device properties and its duration of operation. From the point of view of designers and users, these characteristics of the transformers are considerable in determining the possibility of overloading and the consequences in the lifetime by exploitation at different temperatures. In the present work, the conjugate heat transfer methodology has been employed to predict the thermal and flow properties of investigated object. 3D model has been developed using finite element method and COMSOL program.

articleTitle: Digitization of Education in the Field of Security
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: In the recent years the interest in innovation and implementation of digital solutions in the public sector is growing at a rapid pace, both at global and regional level. The education system is one of the most sensitive sectors in which the effective use of the advantages of digitisation can affect the future of the largest number of people and help for their realization on the labour market[1].

articleTitle: Estimation of Hard Real-Time System Workability
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The growing usage of portable, real time devices, defines the need to have more and more functionalities that are executed in time. Additionally, hard real time services tolerate very limited latencies and for development of this kind of system is critically important to estimate the timing, based on systems' parameters. The current paper analyses a particular hard real-time system, hardware emulator, simulating its behaviour. This makes possible to investigate the system, using a number of different configurations. As a result, it finds dependencies of systems' parameters and defines an algorithm that could estimate the possible maximal latencies.

articleTitle: E-Commerce as a Possibility for the HoReCa Sector in the Plovdiv Region
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The paper presents the results of conducted survey that indicate the problems and opportunities for increasing the competitiveness of the HoReCa sector in Plovdiv and the possibilities of the e-commerce. The research highlights some of the small business owners concerns and underlines the necessity of a type of e-commerce relation between the HoReCa sector representatives and the small food and beverage producers in Plovdiv region.

articleTitle: The Concept of Management of The Development of National Innovation Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Globalization and the innovative way of world economy development in the 21st century are the decisive factors that determine and guide the further development of national economies and their national innovation systems. A key condition for accelerating social and economic development of the country, economy branches, and enterprises is the need to vigorously find and quickly implement in production the most effective innovative proposals. The creation of such conditions ensures the implementation of the innovation process, the ultimate goal of which is the introduction of priority fundamental and applied research, new, advanced technologies, forms of organization of labor and management, based on the achievements of scientific and technological progress.

Author Keywords: models of building national innovation systems

articleTitle: A Nonlinear Moving Target Tracking Control of Nonholonomic Wheeled Mobile Robots
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: This paper considers the problem of designing a feedback controller for a nonholonomic unicycle-type wheeled mobile robot to track a moving target, such that the robot maintains a prescribed distance from the target, as well to follow the target trajectory. We consider the case when the trajectory of the target is unknown in advance, and the only information for the relative position and orientation between the robot and the target used for feedback control, is obtained from an onboard 2D laser scanner. A nonlinear control is proposed, which guarantees ultimate boundedness of the closed-loop system, analyzed by using Lyapunov stability theory. Simulation and experimental results are presented to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed controller.

articleTitle: Secure Audio Information Transmission with Encryption Algorithms in PKI
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Audio information transmission via communication systems must be secure. There are a number of general wide spread methods for secure transmission of audio information like watermarking, steganography, etc. Despite that, it is suitable to develop and test other methods for secure transmission of audio information, based on general principles of secure transmission of information. One of these general methods is Public Key Infrastructure (PKI). Therefore, the goal of this article is to apply PKI for secure audio information transmission, choosing the appropriate and effective encryption algorithms and communication channel characteristics, corresponding to the specifics of the transmitted audio information.

articleTitle: Buyer-Supplier Relationships Impact on Supplier’s Business Processes Improvement
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The goal of the present paper is to present a methodology for dynamically improving the supplier's business processes according to the change in the buyer-suppliers relationships. The methodology allows timely updating of the organizational strategy according to the changes in the environmental and competition factors. It allows identifying the need for business processes improvement, as well as the direction and scope of the improvements when a change in the buyer-supplier relationships is established. For the implementing of the methodology, a computational algorithm is developed.

articleTitle: Facial Identification and Macro Expression Recognition with a New Textural Featuring Approach
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: This work proposes a new feature, based on a textural approach, and targeting for facial identification or macro expression recognition. Approach is similar to classical LBP (Local Binary Pattern) considered in this domain as basis in state of the art by textural featuring approaches. Proposal is developed and, comparatively to LBP, evaluated with success on 2 different databases using an SVM classifier. Experiments are lead on both applications of facial identification and macro expression recognition, and our obtained results overpass LBP.

articleTitle: Cultural and Creative Business through Investment Plan for Europe
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: European economy is under real pressure to be more competitive on a global scale. Having in mind complex and unpredictable political worldwide situation and interesting interactions with other big players, internal factors in European Union itself are also as complicated and contradictory as external (for instance such challenge as Brexit and all consequences for member-states of the European Union). One thing, however, rests indisputable - the great desire and willingness of European Union - to be one of leading players of global economy. This is the reason for continuous research of new possibilities to develop competitive advantages, to prioritize economy sectors with more potential. Cultural and creative industries are defined by European Commission as perspective that could have huge impact and therefore there are different financial instruments for their development. The present paper makes an analysis on the Junker plan implementation for projects in cultural and creative industries.

articleTitle: Effect of Treatment in Copper (II) Electrolyte on the Structure of a Copper/Alumina Nanocomposite
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: In this work, the influence of the template pretreatment in copper (II) electrolyte on the copper electrodeposition into nanoporous anodic aluminium oxide (AAO) was investigated. The galvanostatic electroplating mode was used. It has been established that the stay of the nanoporous template in weak acid solution containing 0.2M copper sulphate up to 20 minutes has a favourable effect on the homogeneity of pore filling. The formation of thin immersion copper layer between aluminium substrate and alumina layer affects the potential-time dependencies and decrease the adhesion between aluminium and the resulting AAO+Cu nanocomposite. The uniformity of nanoporous template filling is examined by cross-sectional observations by scanning electron microscopy.

articleTitle: Reducing the Environmental Impact of Electrical Installations
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Ensuring a safe and environmentally friendly living environment requires the use of modern technological and engineering solutions to design and build high-risk facilities. Dangers to human health include the different electromagnetic fields emanating from power and communication devices. The aim of the project is to find a solution for the construction of a built-in transformer substation with minimal impact on human and the environment in terms of wave emissions.

articleTitle: Prostate Segmentation in Ultrasound Images Using Hybrid Method
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Prostate segmentation in ultrasound images is a challenging problem due to the inherent speckle and some artifacts like shadows, attenuation and signal dropout. In this paper we propose an approach, which includes pre-processing for image enhancement and uses hybrid method, which combines a priori boundary, shape and region information of the prostate to improve the segmentation accuracy. It is based on the active contour model and uses a template matching method to define the initial contour at which the segmentation begins. Some experimental results are presented, obtained by computer simulation in the MATLAB environment. Implementation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the approach for application in screening diagnostics.

articleTitle: Development of Simulation Models for Interactive Audiovisual Control of Students in the E-Learning Environment
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: E-Learning can be defined as an online training or telematics education. This type of platform is used in multiple universities to achieve their strategic goals such as increase the effectiveness of teaching. The advantages of e-learning are the possibility of permanent teacher - student's connection for discussion and explanations. One of the e-learning drawbacks is the impossibility of the teacher to known whether or not students understand correct the e-learning materials. Therefore, the goal of this article is to propose the interactive simulation models for teacher audiovisual control of the student's e-learning process recognizing and analysing their voice and visual emotions.

articleTitle: Consumers’ Behavior of Restaurant Selection
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The main goal of this research is to study the consumer's attitude for choice of a restaurant, that place importance on the ingredients quality and origin, composing the menu and to characterize the potential necessity of developing an online B2B platform, which main purpose is to build a link between local farmers of food and beverages and the representatives of the HoReCa sector in Plovdiv region. B2B commerce is a concept that describes the process of buying and selling of products, services and information and both sellers (suppliers) and buyers are business corporations.Design/Methodology/Approach - The methodology of this study involved conducting surveys and the data are collected from local and foreign tourists (n=250) who visited Plovdiv region.Findings - Based on the analysis, we can find out that one of the main factors, affecting consumers behavior for restaurant selection are quality of the food, demand for fresher and higher quality food products mostly influence the selection of full-service restaurants. Obtained results describes the need of identification trends for environmental movement and growing popularity of locally produced fruit and vegetables, provided by local farmers and agribusinesses.Practical implications - The present study is important because characterize the consumer's behavior toward restaurant selection. From the perspective of B2B platform, the obtained results provide data on how restaurateurs can meet the consumer's desire in order to provide quality food while creating link with local farmers.

articleTitle: E – Learning for IP – Based Telecommunication Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Two major simulation and emulation programs in IP-based networks and generally for telecommunication networks are addressed in the paperwork. A large part of their capabilities and their need for use in the students' learning process are shown. The two products are compared and the advantages and disadvantages are highlighted. In the training of telecommunications specialists and their full balance in knowledge, it is necessary to use both software platforms.

articleTitle: Scientific Research in the Field of Security - Problems and Solutions
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: University education, especially in masters and doctoral programs, is unthinkable without active research. The introduction of new interdisciplinary scientific disciplines, as well as the capacity of non-university research organizations to prepare young scientists, should be encouraged. Bulgaria needs to make significant efforts to change the situation in the security system by increasing the interest in research at higher education institutions, creating conditions for the modern generation of modern knowledge and preparing the new generation of scientists.

articleTitle: Chemical and Electrochemical Growth of Hydroxyapatite on 3D Machined Titanium Alloy
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: In this work was studied the influence of pretreatment and the method of hydroxyapatite (HAp) deposition on Ti6Al4V alloy for its potential application as an implants. A comparative analysis of the morphology and the elemental composition of chemically and electrochemically obtained HAp were presented. Free form samples were pretreated chemically in a strong alkaline solution or were anodized in order to increase adhesion between the deposited HAp layer and the substrate. It has been found that the morphology of HAp crystals depends mainly on the method of deposition and insignificantly on the surface pretreatment methods.

articleTitle: Factors Affecting Business Process Management in the Bulgarian Enterprises to Achieve Sustainable Development
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Because of the complexity and dynamics of the environment there is no universal formula for achieving effective organizational change. Analysis of empirical research proves the positive impact of business process management on the efficiency and functioning of the system but on the condition that they adapt to the specific requirements of the place and time. The purpose of this report is to identify the main factors influencing the effective management of processes for achieving sustainable development in an enterprise. A survey was conducted between September 2017 and March 2018 and a model of influencing factors for effective process management was proposed. The model illustrates the organization's activity, which is influenced by how well-critical factors are balanced with each other. The model investigates causal links that lead to effective business results.

articleTitle: The Marshall Plan as the Path for a Country to Industry-4.0
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: In the research, the information about a gradual transition from classic Industry - 3.0 to Industry - 4.0 (the Fourth industrial revolution) with the use of information and communication technologies (ICT) in a productive process is given. It is shown that a problem of country authentication to Industry-4.0 type by the level of development, productive possibilities, and intellectual potential. The special consideration is given to the countries, where the Marshal Plan concept was implemented. In addition, this study is also applicable to Ukraine and Bulgaria. The analysis of correlation changes for services and commodity volumes is performed on a considerable interval of time. The changes of GDP is also analyzed using the purchasing power parity (PPP). Conclusions show a substantial influence on the level of development for countries that used the Marshall Plan on the basis.

articleTitle: Matlab Modeling of Real Grid for Fault Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: This paper presents matlab model of a 22kV real grid with the aim of detecting different types of faults. The model enables setting the fault location and obtaining the relevant currents in the system. A technique for locating faults on rural distribution feeders has also been suggested. Different faults have been simulated using the developed model. the simulation result have been compared with experimental data from the real grid. It also presents a technique that estimates the exact area of fault on the feeder(real grid). Dissimilar possible types of fault were recorded, tested and few critical results obtained were promising and expected.

articleTitle: A Computational Approach to Teaching the IS-LM Model
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: We present a computational tool that aids the teaching of the popular macroeconomic IS-LM model. The tool presents the constituent parts of the model and allows the study of their properties in isolation. It also illustrates how these components are combined in the complete model and what are the resulting aggregate properties. Thanks to the implementation in IPython in the Jupyter Notebook, the model can be explored interactively in both graphical and numerical modes.

articleTitle: Students’ Unsupervised Experience in Eassessment With the Tesla System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The concept of eAssessment with the adaptive and trust-based TeSLA system is introduced. The TeSLA system is an innovative product developed according to the TeSLA project supported by the European Commission in the scope of the H2020 programme. Students' unsupervised experience in the eAssessment framework during the performed third pilot in the course Electronic Servicing in Public Administration is examined and evaluated through applying the fuzzy approach and the shortest path method. Analysis of the results, as well as relevant discussion and conclusions are proposed. The findings point out the possible paths in the eAssessment environment, consisting of Moodle Learning Management System and the TeSLA system, under unsupervised conditions for achieving rich experience by students. Also, the shortest path is obtained and discussed.

articleTitle: Design and Investigation of Cooling and Oxidation Module for Wine Industry
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The study demonstrates virtual prototyping application in design and evaluation of system complied of two modules for conditioning different types of wine. Explored are two main modules - for cooling and for oxidation of the wine. The design concept built in this study is purposed for a small servings of 10 Cl but it can easily be scaled for bigger volumes. Examined design is based on two main components for cooling that utilizes Peltier components, mounted over aluminum thermo block with serpentine inside and oxidation module based on the Venturi effect to include air portions in the wine. Design development is based on engineering analyses and CFD simulations for developing two main design variants.

articleTitle: Big Data for Business – Challenges and Opportunities for the Bulgarian Economy
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The aim of this paper is to present the main areas of business where the use of big data technologies has significant application and to examine the conditions in these business areas in Bulgaria. The study will make it possible to assess the potential for development of Bulgarian businesses by using the opportunities that big data analysis creates. Effective application of big data in different sectors of the national economy will have an impact on its competitiveness and will enable it, as an equal partner, to take part in the international economic exchange, where Information Communications Technologies (ICT) play a crucial role.

articleTitle: Evaluation and Verification of Series Resonant Converter with Transformer Operating Regimes
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The article presents studies of working modes of a series of resonant DC-DC converter with a transformer. They are also known in the scientific literature and under the name LLC converters. With the help of developed mathematical models of the devices and measurements from experiments of real hardware models, their characteristics are checked. In addition, by controlling the load, information is also gained on the operating modes of the elements of the electrical circuit. Various forms of resonant current flow during operation are taken by varying the load, while changing the output power and the efficiency of the device. The values of the resonant tank parameters and elements that are loaded into the mathematical model are the same as those of the tested type hardware EVLSTNRG-170W from STMicroelectronics. The results of the complex study of the presented modes of this laboratory stand are also useful for verifying the resonant DC-DC transducer model.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Battery Life Versus the Broadcast Interval for Abeacon_46bf
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The present paper calculates the expected life in years for abeacon_46BF with different advertising intervals. Device's current oscillograms are shown. Deep sleep current is measured. Average current consumption for broadcast event is calculated. Average current consumption for 1 transmission and 1 sleep period are calculated for different advertising periods. Battery life predictions for different advertising intervals have been made. Loses due to self discharge are not included. Average consumptions are used because of not equal consumption for each advertising event.

articleTitle: Technical and Economic Justification of the Functions and their Graphic Representation of a High-tech Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Functions and their graphic presentation are some of the most widely used tools in various economic analyses of a business. After a graph is drawn, it is necessary to interpret it correctly in order to accurately assess the situation of the industrial company. The types of functions presented in the paper are viewed in terms of their application in economic analysis. A study of a particular firm has been made, the obtained data has been presented in table form and the graphic approach has been used to depict their functions. The authors have drawn conclusions and have made recommendations.

articleTitle: Survey of How Process Modeling Works in the Bulgarian Organizations
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The development of alternative business models through computer simulation enables the company to identify the strengths and weaknesses of the enterprise as well as the dangers and threats arising from the environment, analyze different options and select the most appropriate model for the enterprise situation. The aim of the present study is to reveal the extent to which Bulgarian companies know the contemporary tools of process management and what techniques they use to model their business processes. The research conducted between September 2017 and March 2018 demonstrates the main thesis of the authors, namely that Bulgarian business is becoming more and more innovative and more adaptable to environmental changes by applying a wide range of business process management tools. A large part of Bulgarian enterprises are becoming more and more mature in their processes, using the broad portfolio of BPM tools, such as Lean and Six Sigma to enhance quality, for automating processes such as workflow and for transformation and radically redesign such as reengineering of the business processes.

articleTitle: Smart People Recruiting
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Will we maintain our dominant position as a dominant species - is this a big fear for humanity about new technologies in the future? In other words, is there a chance that machines and artificial intelligence will displace people. These technologies are aimed at facilitating the lives of people and business organizations, supporting this statement is the current work. The article shows how to select smart city cadres, making it quick, easy and convenient for all stakeholders in the process. The benefits are reciprocal - for people and organizations - by implementing the idea of Smart People Recruiting, it will lead to a reduction in the negative economic phenomenon of unemployment. Technology will not only replace people but increase their standard of living.

articleTitle: Modeling the Vehicle Traction System and Developed Neural Predictive Controller
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: In these paper is developed electric vehicle model and is synthesized neural predictive controller. The vehicle model is consisted mechanical and electrical model and simulation of traction force. The controller changing feed voltage and keeps nominal speed of rotation despite the rapid changes in the mechanical load. Finally is simulated work of close-loop system.

articleTitle: Conditions for Applying the Principles of Total Quality Management to the Requirements of the Fourth Industrial Revolution
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The principles of total quality management in the creation of certain conditions, which can meet the requirements of the Fourth Industrial Revolution. Quality has become one of the decisive factors for increasing the efficiency and competitive advantage of manufactured products. The purpose of this report is to examine development of the total quality management (TQM) in a transition from the existing mode of production to the intelligent industrial production.

articleTitle: Investigation of Electrodynamic Forces in a Flat Induction System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Induction heating is widely used in practice. The evolving electromagnetic and electro-thermal processes allow for the possibility of heating a precisely defined volume in the workpiece at high speed, with low energy consumption. However, large currents generate significant electrodynamic forces between the inductor and the workpiece. On the other hand, due to the specificity of the heating process, the type of inductor used is determined by the geometric shape and the size of the workpiece. In this regard, it is important for practice to evaluate not only the type of inductor in terms of the heating process but also of the direction and magnitude of the evolving electrodynamic forces, which is the object of the present study.

articleTitle: Mechanical Response of a Frictional Seismic Isolator
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The seismic isolation is an attractive option to dissipate the energy transmitted to structures during a strong ground motion and thus mitigate the damage to structural and non-structural elements and to displacement sensitive and acceleration sensitive equipment. The dynamic response of a double pendulum is discussed in this paper in the framework of an approximation of the mechanical response of seismic isolation. The contribution is focused on the formulation of a constitutive relation capable of reproducing the behaviour of hardware for seismic isolation on the macro-scale. The macro-model of the seismic isolation is to be implemented in a finite element model of an isolated structure.

articleTitle: Simulation of Markov Processes through Chains with Complex States
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: At reliability simulations of complex (aggregated) systems, a summary Markov chain is compiled and it have to calculate state transitions through the corresponding mathematical formulas. Here is shown a method of simulation of a summary graph (Markov chain), which does not require conversion of the partial chains and mathematical calculations. Their partial states are included in the so-called complex states. The proposed method allows easy and practical compilation, editing and simulation of Markov chains through the GPSS simulation environment. The results obtained are compared with analytical and standard simulation methods.

articleTitle: General Terms and Conditions for the Radio Connection Jamming
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The distance of the electronic jamming depends on many factors, including the power of the radio transmitting devices of the radio electronic interference devices (REDs), and the devises for electronic jamming (EJ), the characteristics of their antennae systems, the sensitivity of the receiving devices, the conditions of the electromagnetic waves spread, as well as the types of emission and signal processing, the wavelength and the interference protection [1], [3]. In addition, the intensity of interference from local objects, earth (or water) surface, the nature of emissions and the dispersion of electromagnetic waves from the target of the observed RED, are also affected by the distance of the EJ. Reading all factors is quite difficult. In this regard, the remoteness of the RED jamming, and the EJ required power is mathematically calculated on average (on parallel parameters) and is specified in the process of natural (live) testing and mixed modeling.
